extracted text: The material was an aluminium–copper–lithium 2050 alloy (Al base, 3.86% Cu, 0.86% Li, wt %) provided by Constellium (France). It was received as a 50-mm-thick plate obtained by hot rolling, followed by solutioning, water quenching, stretching and natural ageing at room temperature, leading to the T34 metallurgical state. T34 samples were aged at 155°C for 30 h, leading to a T84 metallurgical state.
